guide.description: printf '<format>' <args...> builds output from a template instead of just joining words like echo does. %s substitutes the next argument as-is, %d substitutes it as an integer, and a literal \n inside the format string becomes a real newline — useful for putting multiple values on separate lines out of a single call.

flags.desc: substitute the next argument as a string
substitute the next argument as an integer
a literal newline inside the format string

exercises.title: Two substitutions, one format
exercises.task: Use printf with the format '%s\n%s' to print 'ada' on one line and 'admin' on the next.
